name: What are the benefits of a custom tile shower over a pre-fabricated unit?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of a custom tile shower over a pre-fabricated unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom tile showers offer several advantages over pre-fabricated units, primarily in design flexibility and long-term durability. Custom showers can be tailored to any size or shape, maximizing space and integrating seamlessly with your bathroom's architecture. They allow for a wider range of material choices, design elements like niches and benches, and superior waterproofing. Pre-fabricated units often have limited designs and can sometimes feel less substantial. While the initial cost may be higher, custom showers often provide a higher return on investment and a more luxurious, personalized experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom tile showers offer superior design flexibility, material choices, and durability compared to pre-fabricated units, enhancing value and personalization.
